name: Besai
title: Head of a family of temple servants
summary: Besai is mentioned as the ancestor of a family of Nethinim (temple servants) who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. His descendants were among those who contributed to the rebuilding of the temple and its service. He is listed in the records of returnees in both the book of Ezra and the book of Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Besai's descendants return from exile
keyEvents.description: Besai's descendants were among the temple servants (the Nethinim) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem under Zerubbabel's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Registration in Nehemiah's list
keyEvents.description: Besai's family is also recorded in Nehemiah's list of those who returned from captivity, confirming their role among the temple servants.

keyEvents.title: The role of temple servants in the rebuilding
keyEvents.description: The Nethinim, including Besai's descendants, settled in Jerusalem and served at the rebuilt temple, fulfilling important functions in worship.

keyEvents.title: Renewal of the people's covenant
keyEvents.description: The temple servants, to whom the descendants of Besai belonged, were part of the Jewish community that renewed its covenant with God under Nehemiah's leadership.
